attempted_claim: Let Q be the universal UHF algebra. If A is a unital, simple, separable, nuclear, stably finite, Q-stable C*-algebra and every tracial state on A is quasidiagonal, must A have generalized tracial rank at most one (that is, gTR(A) ≤ 1 in the sense of Definition 2.4 of Elliott–Gong–Lin–Niu)?
decisive_failure: No unconditional proof or disproof is offered. The UCT-conditional YES is not claimed as a new result. All conclusions rest on published classification theorems and on the openly documented status of the Rosenberg-Schochet UCT problem; no new computation or example is presented.
